name: Airlangga
contribution: The only king of the Kingdom of Kahuripan.

checks.lead: Airlangga (also spelled Erlangga), regnal name Rakai Halu Sri Lokeswara Dharmawangsa Airlangga Anantawikramottunggadewa (born 1002 in Bali, Indonesia – died 1049 in Java), was the only king of the Kingdom of Kahuripan.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
